pick.headline: Hungarians vote in the 'four yeses' referendum
pick.summary: On November 26, 1989, Hungarians voted narrowly to delay the presidential election until after a new parliament was chosen, and to abolish the party's workplace cells and militia.
pick.significance: The result denied the reform communists an early presidential vote they expected to win, opening the way to a fully democratic transition.
pick.fbis: The East Europe report of November 27, 1989, carried Budapest coverage around the referendum, including Hungarian political organisations' views on whether it sharpened domestic tensions.
